source_text: Recordabor testamenti; non abiciam in finem. Misericordia superstes. Completae Homiliae XVI in Leviticum. Gloria Christo. Amen.
orientation: Origen is concluding the sixteenth homily on Leviticus with a final recollection of God's covenant mercy, followed by a scribal colophon and doxology.
pass_a_gloss: I will remember [the] testament; I will not cast [it] away in [the] end. Mercy surviving. Completed Homilies 16 on Leviticus. Glory [to] Christ. Amen.

choices.why: Future tense of recordor with genitive object; 'testamentum' here means covenant, not a last will, matching the biblical context of God's covenant with Israel.
rejected: I shall be mindful of the testament

choices.english: I will not cast away to the end
choices.why: Abicio means to cast away or reject; 'in finem' is adverbial, meaning to the end or forever, preserving the negation and future tense.
rejected: I will not cast off at the end

choices.why: Superstes means surviving or remaining; the phrase is a terse affirmation that mercy endures, matching the homiletic closing tone.

choices.english: The Sixteen Homilies on Leviticus are completed
choices.why: This is a scribal colophon; 'completae' is a perfect passive participle agreeing with 'homiliae', rendered as a statement of completion.
rejected: The Sixteen Homilies on Leviticus have been finished

bible_refs.note: Recordabor testamenti echoes the covenant remembrance language of Leviticus 26:44-45, though the exact wording is Origen's summary.

pass_b_english: I will remember the covenant; I will not cast away to the end. Mercy remains. The Sixteen Homilies on Leviticus are completed. Glory to Christ. Amen.

last_rejected.quote: I will remember the covenant; I will not cast away to the end. Mercy remains.
last_rejected.source_quote: Recordabor testamenti; non abiciam in finem. Misericordia superstes.
last_rejected.why: These are Scripture/Psalm verses (Ps 105 LXX/106 Heb), not Origen's own words; speaker unclear
last_rejected.fix: It shall be remembered of his covenant; I will not reject forever. Mercy survives.
last_rejected.ruling: Translation accurately renders source words; speaker attribution is editorial matter, not a translation error changing meaning.
